note: Bhutan, read on 2026-10-31 in the Foreign Direct Investment Rules and Regulations 2025 of the Ministry of Industry, Commerce and Employment (moice.gov.bt), chapter IV 'Investor card, visa and permit' and its definitions. A Work Permit is a permit approved by the Department of Labour and issued by the Department of Immigration to a foreigner, permitting him or her to work in the country; FDI companies may apply for work permits for foreign professional and non-professional expatriates when qualified Bhutanese aren't available, in accordance with the labour and immigration laws. Foreign investors (or their authorised representatives) investing more than Nu. 15 million receive an investor card on the start of business, which approves residence for three years, with further extensions facilitated (written as a means route, term three years, renewable); an investor's spouse may work subject to a work permit. Dependent permits are issued to dependants of professional expatriate employees under the immigration laws. The Rules give no fee, decision time for these, term for the work permit or place of application, and the Department of Immigration's own work permit sheet (doi.gov.bt resets the connection; an archive snapshot of 8 December 2022 exists but couldn't be fetched) wasn't read.

sources.title: Ministry of Industry, Commerce and Employment, Royal Government of Bhutan: Foreign Direct Investment Rules and Regulations 2025
sources.said: Foreign investors or their authorized representatives making investments in an amount exceeding Nu. 15 million shall be provided with investor cards upon the commencement of business. The card shall grant a foreign investor or the authorized representative the approval to reside in the country for a period of three years and further extensions shall be facilitated. ... The Government shall issue dependent permits to dependents of expatriate employees in the professional category in accordance with Immigration laws. ... "Work Permit" means a permit approved by the Department of Labour and issued by the Department of Immigration to a foreigner permitting him/her to work in the country.
